question: How many of the engine's ranked records, and how much of each record's text, must the write review show so that it sees the stored records a write relates to: RELATED_TOP, RELATED_CAP and RELATED_TEXT_CHARS measured on real writes, graded blind.
declared: before any result was read, on the owner's yes of 2026-11-01 ("Yes, run Stage 1"); the owner approved the population below on 2026-11-01 ("Yes, both") before any grade was read

harness_check.rule: review.RELATED_TOP = k, RELATED_CAP = k + 2, the bench's build_states, related_hold
harness_check.p0: HIT: 42 of 44 at k = 3, as run 2 of 2026-10-23 read

replay.method: every mutation row of the log folded into a scratch store (bench/recall/read_rs_f7_p6.py), read just before each write's first commit row; the caller's REVIEW_STRATA admission over the folded membership; the session's disabled scopes and the write's declared supersedes excluded; search.search's clock pinned to the write's first review page

writes.note: no write before 2026-10-21 has a recorded caller (the membership model began recording checkouts that day), so its admission cannot be replayed

sample.rule: every write with a recorded caller and at least one candidate (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-01)

candidates: the engine's set at RELATED_TOP = k for k = 1 to 10 (review.related_for, cue code off, RELATED_CAP = k) and the cue code's admitted targets, shuffled, under neutral labels; a standing write's roster records only counted apart
question_asked: review.QUESTIONS['relation'], word for word, the instructions and the five criteria

window_agreement.judge: openai/gpt-6.1-sol, its window answer against its own full-body answer, on the related pairs

decision.rule: TOP: the smallest k holding at least 90% of the graded-related candidates (cue and roster counted apart); CAP: TOP plus the 95th percentile of cue targets per write; TEXT_CHARS: the smaller of 600 and 1,200 agreeing on at least 90% of pairs, else 4,000

limits: the denominator is the related records inside the engine's top 10: related records still appear at about one in five at ranks 9 and 10, so records past rank 10 are unseen and TOP 9 is the least that holds 90% of what was graded, not of every related record
related means any label but unrelated; 272 of the 417 related pairs were labelled extends by the record judge
in-sample: the writes of one store, 2026-10-21 to 2026-11-01

spend_usd.source: the cost each call returned, summed over the run's response cache (the first judge attempt stopped on an OpenRouter in-flight credit refusal and its completed calls were reused, not repaid)

receipts: ~/.cache/bettermemory-v9/receipts/eng115-stage1-2026-11-01 (check_integrity.py, related.py, candidates.json, packets.json, judged.json, windows.json, analysis-1a.json)
note: Counts and rates only. Write text, record bodies, record ids and prompt text stay in the receipts.
